title: fix(driver-sql): the orphan arm keeps a hash-shadow carrier whose key it could not read, never an orphan drop
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgHNGYL5R2Qt6GA5ZKKhvoKT)_
Fixes #32399

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

Clause-②: no
- The orphan arm of `diffManagedIndexes`, on a #11627 hash-shadow carrier under an ObjectStack generated name whose generation expression could not be read: FROM `unmapped_index` / `drop_index`, categorized `destructive` (performed by `os migrate apply --allow-destructive`) TO kept, nothing offered. No authored key, wire shape, or non-destructive answer moves; the one thing withdrawn is an opt-in drop of a constraint whose key the planner could not read, which `isHashShadowCarrier`'s own contract already ruled out. A RESOLVED orphan carrier is still offered as the drop.

Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none. `git grep -i -E 'hash.?shadow|__hash|shadow carrier|orphan(ed)? index|drop_index' -- skills content/docs` (releases excluded) has 1 hit, `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` line 1182, the `drop_index` row of the index-drift table ("An index carrying ObjectStack's generated naming that metadata no longer declares"). It says what the op means, not that every such index gets it (runtime-managed partial and expression indexes were already excluded without a sentence there), so this change makes it no less true.

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：driver-sql 的 schema 差异比对里，"孤儿索引"这条规则遇到 MySQL/MariaDB 上读不出所哈希键的影子列唯一索引时，不再提议删除（destructive），改为保留、什么都不提议；读得出键的孤儿影子索引照旧提议删除。
2. 为什么改：读不出键就不知道删掉的是哪条唯一约束；`os migrate apply --allow-destructive` 会把它删掉，数据从此静默失去这条约束。加宽分支和重定义分支早已这样处理，只差孤儿分支。
3. 风险与回滚：只会把一条"提议删除"变成"保留"，不新增任何操作；代价是这种读不出键、声明又确实已删掉的影子索引不再出现在计划里（与另两条分支相同的取舍：少一条发现，绝不丢一条约束）。回滚即还原本 PR。
4. 先看：`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts` 里 `diffManagedIndexes` 第 3 段（孤儿分支）新加的一行守卫与注释。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-13015-shadow-carried-index-drift.test.ts`，预期 11 个过、2 个实库单元无 MySQL 时具名跳过（设 `OS_TEST_MYSQL_URL` 则 16 个全跑）；读不出键的影子索引不出现在结果里，读得出键的那个仍是 `drop_index`。
6. 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts`, section 3 of `diffManagedIndexes` (the orphan arm): one guard, `if (isHashShadowCarrier(p) && !p.shadowKey) continue;`, placed after the runtime-managed skip and before the orphan entry is built. It is the redefinition arm's guard, byte for byte, with the same load-bearing `!p.shadowKey` half: a carrier whose key was resolved is not exempted and is still offered as the orphan drop, described by the key it enforced. The widening arm (PR #32356) is untouched.

This is the answer the other two arms already give an unresolved carrier, and the one `SqlDriver.resolveHashShadowKeys`' docblock promises ("`diffManagedIndexes` then reports NOTHING for it ... The degraded outcome is a missing finding, never a dropped constraint"). Before this change the orphan arm broke that promise.

## Why

`isHashShadowCarrier` recognises a carrier by name alone, so it holds even when the generation expression cannot be read, and its jsdoc rules that a carrier "is never a thing this differ may propose destroying on a guess". PR #32356 applied that to the widening arm; the redefinition arm already had it. The orphan arm had no such exemption, so an unresolved carrier under any other generated name (a retired declaration, or a tenant-arm legacy name, which claims no carrier) was offered as `drop_index`, `destructive`. An operator running `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` would drop a unique constraint whose key nobody had read.

## Tests

All in `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-13015-shadow-carried-index-drift.test.ts`, the shared harness for shadow-carried index drift, as one new top-level `describe` plus one live cell (no new file):

- An unresolved carrier no declaration names: no entry of any kind. In the same call, two colocated CONTROLs: a RESOLVED orphan carrier is still `unmapped_index` / `drop_index` / `destructive`, described as `UNIQUE (organization_id, gone)`, and the ordinary drifted unique is still `recreate_index`.
- Outside the widening arm: an unresolved carrier under a tenant-arm legacy name (no `widenedBy`) is kept; the whole diff is empty.
- CONTROL: the same carrier with its key read is still the orphan `drop_index`.
- The widening arm's unresolved-carrier answer from PR #32356 is unchanged (kept, nothing offered).
- Live MySQL cell: two retired shadow-carried UNIQUEs built by `initObjects`; one shadow is rebuilt with a generation expression that names no column (`UNHEX(SHA2('unreadable', 256))`), which `resolveHashShadowKeys` resolves to nothing. A fresh driver with neither declared: the resolved one is offered as `drop_index`, the unreadable one is not; after `applyMigrationEntries(drift, { allowDestructive: true })` the catalog still holds the unreadable index and no longer holds the resolved one.

## Acceptance notes

- **"Kept and reported".** The card's expected text says the carrier is "kept and reported", and also that this is "the widening arm's answer after PR #32356". The widening arm's answer is kept with nothing in the plan, and so is the redefinition arm's; no report-only finding exists for an unresolved carrier on any arm (`DriftOp` has none, and `resolveHashShadowKeys` documents "reports NOTHING"). This PR gives the orphan arm exactly the widening arm's answer and adds no new finding kind. A report-only entry would be a new `DriftOp` member, an exported shape the CLI renders; it is named in the seat report as an open question, not built here.
- **The trade.** A carrier whose declaration really is gone and whose key cannot be read is no longer listed at all, so its STORED generated column stays until the key is readable again. That is the same missing-finding trade the redefinition arm makes, chosen over a guessed drop.
- **Overlap.** Open PR #32306 also edits `schema-drift.ts`, in the widening arm (section 1); this hunk is in section 3 only. Whichever merges second merges `origin/main` first.

## Verification

Measured on `origin/main` `7d82b2dab` + this branch (head `1ead60236`), with a live MySQL 8.0.46 (`mysql:8.0`, the image CI's live job uses) in this container.

<details><summary>Red first, on unfixed main (live MySQL 8.0.46)</summary>

The card's first step: an unreadable carrier does reach the orphan arm on a live server. On `7d82b2dab` with only the new tests added, `OS_TEST_MYSQL_URL=… vitest run src/sql-driver-13015-shadow-carried-index-drift.test.ts`: `Tests 3 failed | 13 passed (16)`, live mysql RAN. The live cell's subject assertion received:

```
"kind": "unmapped_index", "category": "destructive",
"actual": "UNIQUE (uniq_os32399_orphan_unreadable__hash)",
"op": { "type": "drop_index", "indexName": "uniq_os32399_orphan_unreadable", ... }
```

The two pure-function subject pins failed the same way; every CONTROL and every pre-existing test passed. (A MariaDB 11.8 run was tried first: MariaDB keys a long TEXT unique natively and takes no shadow route, so the shadow cells, the pre-existing #13015 ones included, do not apply there.)

</details>

<details><summary>Green</summary>

- The new file plus `sql-driver-widened-grant-key.test.ts` (the PR #32356 pins) and `sql-driver-13056-orphan-shadow-column-cleanup.test.ts`, live MySQL: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 49 passed (49)`, VERDICT `command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql test` (no live URL): `Test Files 250 passed | 13 skipped (263)`, `Tests 4229 passed | 228 skipped (4457)`, VERDICT `command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql run typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --listFiles` includes the test file).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (once)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head replaced the new guard line with a marker comment (anchor 1 → 0, blob `08055dc8f89c` → `c063c9a460c2`), live MySQL: `Tests 3 failed | 13 passed (16)`, the three subject pins (pure unresolved orphan, tenant-arm legacy name, live cell); every CONTROL and the widening-arm pin stayed green. Restored by the tool: blob back to `08055dc8f89c`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

On `1ead60236` (the final tree; `git merge origin/main` before opening: already up to date at `7d82b2dab`):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 66 commands over the 3 changed paths (200 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold). Each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe.
- First pass: 62 exited 0, 4 exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, not findings): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (its fixture commit was outside this shallow clone; the commit was fetched), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:type-check-debt` (they read built output of packages outside driver-sql's closure; `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2`, 120 of 120 tasks, VERDICT `command-exit 0`). All four re-run: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: **66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide `eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0. eslint over the two touched source files: exit 0.

</details>

**NOT MEASURED here:** MariaDB with a shadow carrier (MariaDB takes no shadow route for this shape, see above); the full dogfood battery (no `!` title and no `(narrowing)` arm).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Repo-wide `pnpm lint`: exit 0.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (`## 维护者速读` is the maintainer's Chinese summary the dispatch rules ask for.)
